notes.title: Demo Update Version 0.1.0.2
notes.content: [h2]Updated since previous version (0.1.0.1):[/h2][p]	- Added new music[/p][p]	- Improved UI[/p][p]	- Turn summary pops up every turn[/p][p]	- Added a name display to every building[/p][p]	- Characters now indicate when they are ready for a breakthrough[/p][p]	- Changed the skills to numbered levels instead of confusing wording[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing![/p][p][i]— Alena & Anna[/i] [/p]

notes.title: The second Playtest is now live!
notes.content:
Join us from [b]March 23rd to April 2nd[/b] for the second playtest of the Sect Leader’s Decree!

We’d love to hear your thoughts — give it a try and share your feedback!

[i]Note: While the full game will support multiple languages, this playtest is English-only.[/i]

Changes from the Playtest 1 version:
	- Added a step by step tutorial 
	- Added a river square, allowing for fishing 
  - Cooking recipes now show total amount of resources needed, instead of being per Character 
	- Changed wording on some Events 
	- Tabs in the buildings are more visible now 
	
Fixed bugs: 
	- Fixed skills shown as invalid in some places  
	- When building is decayed completely, the cost to repair it only increases to a limit of how much it would cost to construct this building from scratch 
	- Fixed the bug when cooking the same recipe in two kitchens would, the second one would override the first 

[i]— Alena & Anna [/i]
